checks.name: Private detail requires a current owner session, never a permanent key or another owner
Ordinary seen, responsibility, due, attempted, reached, completion and reopen retain distinct history without source edits
Corrected phone requires new contact evidence while preserving the previous phone history
Exact operation replay returns one receipt; changed input under its identity is rejected
Competing conditional actions retain one winner and return a useful conflict
Meaningful source changes require review while routine timestamps do not reset work
Malformed dates, unknown fields and oversized notes are rejected before a journal write
Foreign and prior-incarnation records cannot be adopted by a matching slug
Revocation before conditional journal evaluation prevents mutation
Canceled workspaces retain readable history and committed receipts but reject fresh work
Lost write responses reconcile the same receipt without another action
Failed writes remain uncertain until read; exact retry saves once
Owner list projects completed work separately from source status and excludes setup work
Daily, weekly and monthly projections use owner-recorded completion without treating it as a completed visit
Malformed identity field types cannot become replay identities
